facts.fact: Eswatini Positive News reports that the Government-In-Your-Hand app, launched in May 2025, lets entrepreneurs register and manage businesses from home, per the ICT ministry.

Eswatini's ICT ministry launched the Government-In-Your-Hand app in May 2025, offering document status checks, business registration, education services and utility payments, with no count of services given.

The Government-In-Your-Hand app carries services of several bodies (ID and passport status, business registration, education loans, utility payments), with sign-up by national ID and an SMS one-time code, per Eswatini Positive News.
An ICT ministry engineer said the Government-In-Your-Hand app had over 2,000 downloads in its first month, and that over 200 people had it on their phones.

facts.fact: Eswatini Positive News reports that users can pay for a variety of government services directly from mobile money accounts through the Government-In-Your-Hand app.
